name: Varicella-zoster virus (chickenpox)
short_description: Enveloped herpesvirus (human alphaherpesvirus 3, ~180-200 nm, pleomorphic) with the classic four-layer herpesvirus architecture: a ~125 kbp linear dsDNA genome inside a T=16 icosahedral capsid of 162 capsomeres, the capsid cushioned by the granular tegument, the whole wrapped in a lipid envelope studded with short blunt glycoprotein spikes. Causes chickenpox, then goes latent for life in sensory nerve ganglia and can reactivate decades later as shingles.
